name: appliance-sounds
description: Classifies a short audio clip into 10 household appliance sound classes. YAMNet produces a 1024-value embedding per 0.48 s frame; the frames are averaged and a small dense network trained by the team predicts the class.
architecture: Input(1024) > Dense(512, relu) > Dropout(0.3) > Dense(256, relu) > Dropout(0.3) > Dense(10, softmax)

backbone.name: YAMNet
backbone.use: Frame embeddings averaged over the clip; YAMNet itself is not retrained.

training.data: audio_datasets/appliance_audio — YAMNet auto-labelled, 100 clips across 10 classes
